title: Overriding a method
summary: A child can replace an inherited method with its own version. This is called overriding.
introduction: A child can replace an inherited method with its own version. This is called overriding. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A child can replace an inherited method with its own version. This is called overriding.

blocks.title: Overriding a method

blocks.text: The result is woof. Dog supplies its own speak method.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a Cat class whose speak method returns meow.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Keep the method purpose clear when replacing it in a child.
For more detail later, use this [Object-Oriented Programming further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Advanced_JavaScript_objects).
